generalInfo.label: REPORTS.VIEW_REPORT.INSPECTOR_REMARK
generalInfo.value:
1. Product Description - The product name on the client PO sheet does not match the product name on the inner pack - ( Factory provided client approved mail, there is subject only mentioned January delivery concern, accordingly mentioned NOT OK )
2. Outer Packing: Assortment, Dims & Weight Result – NOT OK - Factory did not meet the client required carton dimensions found during the inspection 70 cm x 33 cm x 47 cm ( L x H x W ) - ( The factory provided a mail regarding the above dimension issue, stating that new dimensions are being followed. However, there is no clarification of client approval for the revised dimensions )
3. Inner Packing – NOT OK - Incorrect color sequence was found. Incorrect folding direction was observed; garments were inserted into the inner box in the wrong orientation
4. Unit Packing – NOT OK - Incorrect color sequence was found. Incorrect folding direction was observed; garments were inserted into the inner box in the wrong orientation
5. Item Packaging – NOT OK - Incorrect color sequence was found. Incorrect folding direction was observed; garments were inserted into the inner box in the wrong orientation
6. The PP sample indicates two SKUs under the same PP sample. The factory also provided an internal email confirming that both SKUs follow the same PP sample
7. Factory offered quantity 3470 pcs against booked quantity 4000 pcs.
• Shortage qty - 530 pcs
• Percentage - 86.75%
• Total cartons - 36
• Selected cartons – 15
8. PP Sample approved by MDS
9. Trim card / shade bands approved by internally
10. All the documents, samples, and trim cards provided by the factory were checked, and the inspection was done accordingly
11. Carton Packing and Specification General – N/A – Carton mark and numbers not completed during the inspection
12. Carton Packing and Labelling – N/A – Carton mark and numbers not completed during the inspection
13. Carton Labelling & Identification Requirements – N/A – Carton mark and numbers not completed during the inspections
14. The factory did not repack the inspected garments in front of the QIMA inspector due to time constraints and a shortage of manpower required for the hand-to-hand packing process. As the supplier needed extra time to complete the repacking, no observations could be made by the QIMA inspector regarding the repackaging of the inspected garments

alsoWorthNoting.description: The factory supplied 3,470 pieces against the booked quantity of 4,000 pieces, resulting in a shortage of 530 pieces (86.75%). Total cartons: 36; selected cartons: 15.

recommendedActions.actionContent: Before approving an inspection, verify the shipped quantity with the factory, especially if the production quantity is lower than your purchase order. This helps prevent confusion upon product arrival and avoids invoice discrepancies.

alsoWorthNoting.description: Carton packing and specification: N/A. Carton marks and numbers were not completed during the inspection.

recommendedActions.actionContent: Ensure that each carton is clearly labeled with item details, quantities, and destination information, utilizing barcode or QR code systems for accuracy on each carton for easy verification.

alsoWorthNoting.description: The factory did not repack the inspected garments in front of the QIMA inspector due to time constraints and insufficient manpower for hand-to-hand packing. As the supplier required additional time, the QIMA inspector could not observe the repacking process.

recommendedActions.actionContent: Inspected pieces must be repacked by the factory at the end of the inspection under QIMA's supervision to ensure no defective pieces are included in the shipments.

alsoWorthNoting.description: The PP sample includes two SKUs under the same sample. The factory provided an internal email confirming both SKUs follow the same PP sample.
Trim card and shade bands approved internally.
